high_level_description: The image depicts a decorative tile with a vibrant and intricate design. The tile is square-shaped and features a central floral motif surrounded by smaller floral elements. The background of the tile is a deep red color, which contrasts sharply with the white and yellow flowers. The central floral motif consists of a large, symmetrical arrangement of yellow flowers with blue centers, each flower having six petals. These flowers are connected by green stems and leaves, creating a cohesive and balanced design.
